subject: About the reason of "primary model did not converge"

messages.author: f1ae5e544d780548
messages.subject: About the reason of "primary model did not converge"
parts:
Hi, thanks for the great tool! I'm fitting a model to dissect two GWAS into three parts (one shared component and two unique components):

model<-'common=~NA*A + NA*B
        a=~NA*A
        b=~NA*B
        
         a~~1*a
         b~~1*b
         common~~1*common
        a~~0*b
         common~~0*b
         a~~0*common

         A ~~ 0*A
        B~~0*B
         B~~0*A'

and the error was like:

> output1<-usermodel(LDSCoutput,estimation="DWLS",model=model)
[1] "Running primary model"
     lhs op rhs Unstandardized_Estimate
1 common =~ A               0.4214000
2 common =~ B               0.3675678
3    a=~ A               0.2441082
4    b =~ B               0.2223087
Warning message:
In usermodel(LDSCoutput, estimation = "DWLS", model = model) :
  Error: The primary model did not converge! Additional warnings or errors are likely being printed by lavaan. 
            The model output is also printed below (without standard errors) in case this is helpful for troubleshooting. Please note that these results should not be interpreted.

The LDSC result is also provided below. Could you give some suggestion on the possible reason for this issue? Thank you very much for your help!

> LDSCoutput
$V
             [,1]         [,2]         [,3]
[1,] 1.333847e-04 5.331030e-05 6.678712e-05
[2,] 5.331030e-05 1.004007e-04 9.706287e-05
[3,] 6.678712e-05 9.706287e-05 2.083432e-04

[2,] 0.1548931 0.1845272

messages.author: ac421cf36d1a4c37
messages.subject: Re: About the reason of "primary model did not converge"
parts:
A two indicator factor model is not identified without added constraints such as equality of factor loadings. 
Otherwise you are attempting to estimate 4 parameters but only have 3 unique elements in your S matrix to model, leading to negative df.  

Elliot M. Tucker-Drob
